note: Sessions research.py leaves out by default: these sessions already shaped the hypotheses, or are the forward test's to judge. A hypothesis cannot be tested on the data it was picked from. --include-burned puts them back for exploring only: nothing can pass then.

windows.why: edge.py's 1,536-rule grid ran on these sessions (Yahoo's 60 days to 6 November 2026), and the hypotheses in hypotheses.example.json, the frozen orb30 short among them, were picked from what it found
the forward test (forward.py, frozen on 10 November 2026) judges the frozen rule on these sessions, so counting them here too would count the same trades twice
